cohort: Ten patients with fumarate hydratase (FH)-deficient uterine leiomyomas who underwent HIFU ablation at a specific hospital between July 2017 and January 2023.
finding: HIFU ablation is a safe and feasible treatment for FH-deficient uterine leiomyomas, showing short-term effectiveness in symptom relief but high reintervention rates and limited long-term effects.
